20-6.benefit: Honey can contain Clostridium botulinum spores, which a baby's gut cannot yet handle. Do not give honey, including as a sweetener on a pacifier or in a home remedy, to a child under 12 months. The risk is infant botulism, a rare but serious illness. After the first birthday, honey is safe for most children. This is the advice of the World Health Organization and the American Academy of Pediatrics.
